facts.text: Jolene's partner helps her stay focused on gaming goals and they share photos of their time together.

evidence.quote: My partner helps me stay focused on our goals. We have a lot of cute photos, I want to share with you.

facts.text: Jolene and her partner enjoy gaming together as it allows them to tackle challenges and bond.
